name: Fruition — documents & decks
description: The Fruition house style for generated documents and slide decks: tokens, the fr-* class vocabulary, and print geometry for A4 and 16:9.

source.origin: Fruition Design System (Claude Design export), reconciled against src/app/globals.css

notes: tokens.ts, doc.ts and slides.ts export CSS as TypeScript strings rather than shipping .css files, because the Cloudflare Worker that renders these documents has no filesystem. An imported open-design kit's tokens.css converts by wrapping it in a template literal.
